name: JetBrains Air
desc: Agent workspace inside IntelliJ IDEs that runs any ACP-compatible coding agent.
desc_zh: IntelliJ IDE 内的智能体工作区，可运行任何兼容 ACP 的编程智能体。
solves: Agents ran in their own window and the IDE could not see their work; here sessions, diffs and feedback sit inside the editor you already use.
solves_zh: 智能体过去跑在自己的窗口里，IDE 看不到它在做什么；现在会话、diff 和反馈都在你已经在用的编辑器里。
best_for: You work in IntelliJ IDEA and want Claude Code or Codex working beside your own inspections and run configurations.
best_for_zh: 平时用 IntelliJ IDEA，想让 Claude Code 或 Codex 在自己的检查和运行配置旁边干活。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — blog.jetbrains.com/air RSS feed and jetbrains.com/air）。 Early access opened 2026-10-01; general availability with the IDE 2026.3 release on 2026-11-11. Shipped as a plugin inside existing JetBrains IDEs and replaces AI Assistant there. Distinct from Junie, which is one of the agents Air can host. JetBrains presents Air as a wider product system that also covers Air Teams and Air Governance; only the in-IDE surface has a first-party dated launch page found here. 入库核对（2026-11-25）：产品名是 JetBrains Air；「in IDEs」只是它的形态，记录在 form/surface 里。 首次公开日期来源：https://blog.jetbrains.com/air/feed/
